name: the hive
headline: The *hive*: a workspace made of cells
say: Hypercomb is a live, presence-based workspace. Your content lives on a hexagonal grid of cells — tiles. A tile can hold anything: a picture, a note, a document, a game, a whole website. Click a tile and you travel into it — every tile can open into another full honeycomb of its own. That is the whole navigation model: the hive is a tree of honeycombs, and you fly through it. What you're watching is a real hive — a family archive, a cigar lounge, an A.I. research collection, a behaviors library — all tiles, all the way down.
